rationale: Proceed to the blinded, pre-specified multi-lot, multi-site feasibility experiment as described, because the approach is conceptually aligned with MISEV guidance but lacks direct empirical support. The planned study must explicitly address the highest-risk failure modes (consistent co-isolation/assay-interference, detergent/protease protection controls, spike-ins/buffer-compatibility, pilot-lot yield and stability, and inter-lab harmonization) before the fingerprint can be used as a non-numeric comparability gate.
